title: cop.assertion/v1
description: Proposition known, held, or considered by the Corpus with explicit epistemic status and stable identity (Issue #61, #63). Revisions preserve history without mutating contradictory evidence.

assertion_id.description: Stable canonical assertion identifier across revisions (e.g. ast:<uuid>).

revision.description: Monotonic revision number of this assertion.

claim.description: The propositional statement or structured claim held by the Corpus.

subject_ref.description: Subject reference or entity to which this assertion pertains.

asserted_by.description: Attributable identity (LogicalAgent, Principal, system rule) asserting the proposition.

supersedes_id.description: Identifier or ref of a prior revision superseded by this assertion.
